text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while taking photos of the 
Umamusume racing to use as reference 
materials for training……

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Is it just my imagination? For some 
reason, it feels like one particular 
Umamusume keeps photobombing—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: While taking photos on another day...
choice_data_list: Aren't you the one from the other day—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, you noticed me. A momentary lapse 
on Ma-chan's part.
choice_data_list_en: Wait, weren't you the one the other day who—
Wait, weren't you also the one who, the other day—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Ma-chan just can't help it... whenever 
there's a camera around, she gets all 
antsy...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I simply find myself photobombing――driven 
by the urge to leave a bit of Ma-chan in 
everyone's hands, so I can't help but step 
into frame.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
――Oh-ho, speak of the devil and a 
photobomb opportunity appears. Well then, 
well then, off I go.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Street photobombing, what in the world...? 
Does she just like being photographed?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That night, while sorting through the 
photos I took――

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan is in every single photo I've 
ever taken...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On another day, I set up my camera again. 
And then—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, we meet again. It's the world's 
most coincidental Ma-chan.
choice_data_list: I have a favor to ask.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Well now, whatever could it be?
choice_data_list: ひとつお願いがあるんだけど
choice_data_list_en: I have one favor to ask.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
My, a passionate modeling offer? Ma-chan is 
deeply touched.
choice_data_list: 写真のモデルになってみない？
華麗な辻写りの極意が知りたい
choice_data_list_en: Would you like to model for a photo?
I want to know the secret to taking stylish street snaps.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I explained that I was looking for an 
Umamusume who would let me record her 
running for training materials.
choice_data_list:
They seem to like getting their picture 
taken...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Yes, I would be delighted to accept.
choice_data_list: 写真に撮られるの好きみたいだから……
choice_data_list_en: Because it seems like they like having their picture taken...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Ma-chan just likes... leaving something 
behind.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Aston Machan, I was able to 
complete the training materials ahead of 
schedule.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Hoho, so you seek instruction from Ma-chan, 
the roving snapshot artist...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe, very well. The Ma-chan Dojo is 
officially open.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
In return――make sure you remember this 
loud and clear when you head back, okay?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Understood? First off, the key is 
*pitter-patter*. Not *whoooosh*. It is 
*pitter-patter*.
